items.title: Mellum2.1 Instruct Is Out, Bringing Faster Answers for Coding Agents
items.en_title: Mellum2.1 Instruct Is Out, Bringing Faster Answers for Coding Agents
items.en_oneliner: JetBrains releases a lighter sibling of Mellum2.1, aimed at sub-agents, tool-call loops, and chat, with quicker responses.

items.title: An Indic Voice Agent with CUGA
items.en_title: An Indic Voice Agent with CUGA
items.en_oneliner: IBM Research built a voice assistant for Indian farmers on the open-source CUGA agent harness: ask aloud in a local language and it searches an English farming handbook, then answers by voice in that same language, with multilingual embeddings solving the cross-lingual retrieval problem.

items.title: Release v1.0.0-preview.2
items.en_oneliner: Qwen Code v1.0.0-preview.2 adds Qwen4-Max to the subscription catalog (1M context, image and video input), shows a reset countdown when credits run out, and adds an /upgrade command that opens the plans page.
Claude Code 2.1.332 brings in beta support for skills served by MCP servers, plus a PreSkillShellCommand hook that can refuse inline scripts before a skill or command runs.

items.title: The Agent Lake
items.en_oneliner: LangSmith's Agent Lake gathers every trace agents produce, surfaces the high-signal ones, and converts them into fixes and fine-tuning data.

items.title: How We Achieved ISO 42001 with LangSmith
items.en_title: How We Achieved ISO 42001 with LangSmith
items.en_oneliner: LangSmith helped LangChain secure ISO/IEC 42001 certification for its AI management system, and the team explains the process behind it.

items.title: Hill-climbing Inkling 2 Mini inference on one RTX PRO 6000
items.en_title: Hill-climbing Inkling 2 Mini inference on one RTX PRO 6000
items.en_oneliner: Hill-climbing tuning squeezes faster Inkling 2 Mini inference out of a single RTX PRO 6000.

items.title: v1.107.11 (2026-11-24)
items.en_oneliner: A small patch update on the Pydantic AI 1.x line, focused on routine fixes.

items.title: v2.74.0 (2026-11-24)
items.en_oneliner: Pydantic AI 2.74.0 adds a computer-use tool contract to the core, letting agents call ComputerTool directly to operate a computer.

items.title: How Gemini is changing the game for Golden State's organization and fans.
items.en_title: How Gemini is changing the game for Golden State's organization and fans.
items.en_oneliner: Google is bringing Gemini into the Warriors' fan experiences and day-to-day operations at Chase Center, showing how AI works in a live sports setting.
